subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — OTEL and Prometheus exporter mappings

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these six AI-safety event types and their 15 public SDK exports as a supported core contract before the exporter layer is merged?
rationale: The current PR carries prerequisite contract commits, and accepting those names, payloads, trust semantics, and SDK exports is a lasting product and compatibility decision rather than a mechanical exporter repair.

options.title: Approve contracts, then rebase
options.body: Confirm the taxonomy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107176, merge it first, and rebase this PR so only exporter wiring and focused validation remain.

options.title: Keep taxonomy internal
options.body: Remove public SDK exports and plugin-facing assumptions, then implement only internal core telemetry until a public contract is separately sponsored.

options.title: Pause the series
options.body: Keep the related PRs unmerged until maintainers agree on the event taxonomy, producer ownership, and observability product direction.

recommendation.title: Approve contracts, then rebase
recommendation.body: Confirm the taxonomy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107176, merge it first, and rebase this PR so only exporter wiring and focused validation remain.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person to the original diagnostics-otel architecture, which is the central owner boundary for the proposed core telemetry contract.
